target.title: fix(sessions): reject malformed history offsets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users requesting `sessions_history` pagination could pass malformed string offsets such as `"1abc"` and have them accepted as offset `1` instead of being rejected before `chat.history` dispatch.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both the public `sessions_history` tool and the embedded `chat.history` gateway stub now reuse the existing strict non-negative integer parameter reader for `offset`, matching the schema contract and the strict `limit` parsing already used in the same paths. This keeps the fix local to the session history owner boundary and avoids changing pagination behavior for valid numeric offsets.

## User Impact

Malformed offset values are rejected consistently, so session-history pagination cannot silently run from a different page than the caller requested.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: malformed string offsets are rejected in both the public `sessions_history` tool path and the embedded `chat.history` gateway stub path, before malformed pagination can dispatch or read history.
- Current-head real behavior proof at `ea64b57a1a00168496b178f2a97b8932dc22f33a`: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` invoked `createSessionsHistoryTool().execute(...)` and `createEmbeddedCallGateway()({ method: "chat.history", ... })` with `offset: "1abc"`.

```text
HEAD ea64b57a1a00168496b178f2a97b8932dc22f33a
sessions_history offset="1abc": rejected name=ToolInputError message="offset must be a non-negative integer"
sessions_history gateway dispatched=false
embedded chat.history offset="1abc": rejected name=ToolInputError message="offset must be a non-negative integer"
```

- Focused regression tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/sessions-history-tool.test.ts src/agents/tools/embedded-gateway-stub.test.ts` passed with 2 files and 27 tests.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Branch refresh: `git rev-list --count HEAD..upstream/main` returned `0` at proof time after merging current `upstream/main`.
